disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; two independent clinical cohorts: HCP discovery cohort (140 SCZ cases from HCP-Psychosis) and ASRB validation cohort (335 SCZ cases). Total clinical N=475.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis); and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB). [...] n = 1267 comprising 140 cases [...] and 1127 controls [...]. The ASRB dataset was used to evaluate replicability and validity (n = 520 comprising 335 cases [...] and 185 controls"

dataset-of-origin.detail: SCZ cases drawn from two datasets: HCP-Psychosis (HCP-EP; n=140 cases, discovery cohort) and Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB; n=335 cases, validation cohort). HCP-Young Adult contributed healthy controls only (not clinical cohort).

answer.note: weighted mean and pooled SD across HCP-EP SCZ (n=140, mean=22.78, SD=3.83) and ASRB SCZ (n=335, mean=39.70, SD=10.81)

age.detail: Cohort-specific values are presented separately: HCP-EP SCZ: mean=22.78, SD=3.83 (n=140); ASRB SCZ: mean=39.70, SD=10.81 (n=335). Weighted mean = (140×22.78 + 335×39.70)/475 = 34.71 years; pooled SD = sqrt(((139×3.83²)+(334×10.81²))/473) = 9.32 years. Min/Max not reported. 値はコホート別に提示されているため、加重平均・プールドSDを算出した。
